hypothesis: When the likelihoods leave two hypotheses exactly tied, a contextual fact supplied as a phase lets the amplitude state decide, where a probability vector cannot.
null_hypothesis: The phase adds nothing a probability vector could not be given as ordinary evidence; any gap against the uninformed control is the extra information and not the representation.
information_note: oqca_phase receives the fact as a half-turn of phase on one member of the tied pair. bayes_informed receives THE SAME FACT as a likelihood vector. vector_context receives it as a real-valued context feature. bayes_uninformed receives NOTHING beyond the likelihoods and must break the tie by index order. The phase is DERIVED FROM THE TRUTH by the generator, so this measures whether a representation can carry a supplied fact and never whether it can infer one.
expected_behaviour: oqca_phase near 100%; bayes_informed and vector_context also near 100% (which falsifies any representation claim); bayes_uninformed near 50% because the tie is broken by index and the truth is randomised.
